## Verified related picker/saver state batch — 2026-10-29

All **five original IO-017 acceptance criteria** were reviewed against actual source/results before closure:

- **Recompose maxItems 2 to 5 and null to limit:** Four retained desktop2/5/null/1 per-launch result/configuration rounds reused on Linux/macOS/Windows at95ac/046628; new four genuine PHPicker2/5/null/1 configurations atdde3.
- **Swap Compose parent window:** Retained desktop picker swaps actual Compose windows (accepted unchanged3host case); new saver swaps local parents and tests explicit precedence over a different local parent on all3hosts.
- **Toggle iOS Compatible/Current:** Four actual presented PHPicker configurations alternate Compatible/Current; live recomposition does not mutate the active controller.
- **Change callback while picker open:** Both desktop picker/saver current completion callbacks after held operations and iOS current callback after live recomposition; duplicate controlled native delegate calls deliver once.
- **No stale/duplicate native handles after update:** Per-launch real JNI unique IDs, lease closes and stale-ID rejection; real UIKit native delegate retained through each active controller/dismissal and owner reused only after teardown; deferred cancellation/exception regressions retain files/delegates until real completion.

**New important results:** iOS UIKit application [40840589911](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40840589911) at `dde3a2a9f24fc0f496799354429052f3208b5a3b`: **9/9**, Gradle exit0/780.31s, three fresh XML, exact856 Git-bound inputs; independent real native protocol/XML agreement, Worker termination, binary/runtime-before/after and owned install/cleanup verified. All four real PHPicker launches, actual export-cancellation safe point, two deferred-call/exception ownership regressions and repeated BasicText root pass. Original19 accepted Foundation/filter/copy/staging methods were **not** replayed.

Desktop saver [40837989337](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40837989337) at `0333e18afcdb00fbfefaf001b52a306368dcc8c7`: **1/1 on Linux, macOS and Windows**, three executions of one authored method; exact854 Git-bound inputs each. Existing accepted unchanged three-host picker state evidence from [40817067140](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40817067140) and [40815285475](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40815285475) is explicitly reused, not counted fresh.

**Root repair:** retained launchers read updated settings/parent/selection/representation values, snapshot each accepted operation, retain native/session ownership through genuine teardown and use the current completion callbacks. UIKit void-call nil links no longer falsely reject/drop delegates or staging. Public APIs/packages/JNI names preserved.

**Independent limitations stay open:** #8/#44/#50/#54 require other provider/export/swipe/platform criteria; #58 covers real native parent lease/thread/backend lifetime. Controlled result/delegate transport and parent0 do not prove OS chooser selection, native parenting, GPU, physical/minimum-platform, full ABI/consumer, dependency/legal/security or release readiness. Never-completing OS refusals still retain ownership fail-closed. Prior failed CI evidence is preserved. No packages, releases, deployments or Pages.

Closing this verified subset immediately after the shared important-test/original-criteria review, without waiting for unrelated whole-release gates. Additive detailed receipts/readbacks follow under `docs/development/evidence/ios-admission-important-20261029/`.
